## Core Business Services (6 Categories)
1. Turnkey Home Interior: 3BHK & 4BHK Villa Fit-Outs, Living & Dining Styling, Master Bedroom Suites, Kids Room, Pooja Room Mandir Architecture, Balcony & Bar Lounges. (Budget: Rs. 10L to Rs. 1.5Cr+)
2. Modular Kitchen: German Tandem Island Kitchens, U-Shape & Parallel Kitchens, Acrylic & PU Lacquer Shutters, Action Tesa HDHMR Waterproof Cabinets, Blum & Häfele Soft-Close Hardware, Dekton Sintered Countertops. (Budget: Rs. 5L to Rs. 50L+)
3. Custom Wardrobe: Floor-to-Ceiling Sliding Wardrobes, Walk-in Closets, Tinted Glass & Lacquered Acrylic Storage, Integrated Sensor LED Lighting, Hettich Hydraulic Organizers. (Budget: Rs. 1.5L to Rs. 12L+)
4. False Ceiling & Lighting: Gypsum Perimeter Cove Ceiling, Wooden Louver & Baffle Paneling, Magnetic Track Spotlighting, CNC Jali & Stretch Ceiling, Acoustic Cinema Ceiling, Smart Dimming Strip Lighting. (Budget: Rs. 1L to Rs. 5L+)
5. Civil Construction & Renovation: Structural Masonry, CPVC 10-Bar Pressure Plumbing, FRLS Fire-Safe Heavy Duty Rewiring, Italian Marble & Slab Tiling, Terrace Waterproofing, Luxury Vanity & Bathroom Upgrades. (Budget: Rs. 10L to Rs. 1.5Cr+)
6. Office & Commercial Interior: Executive Workstations & Cabins, Acoustic Conference Rooms, Reception & Brand Walls, Cafeteria Fit-Outs, Raised Access Flooring, HVAC & Fire Systems. (Budget: Rs. 10L to Rs. 80L+)

## Key Material Standards & Engineering Specs
- Board Grades: Action Tesa HDHMR (High Density High Moisture Resistance - 1450 kg/m3), CenturyPly Club Prime Marine Plywood (BWP 710).
- Cabinet Shutters: 18mm German PU Lacquer finish, 2mm Seamless Acrylic with ABS Edge Banding.
- Hardware & Drawers: Blum Legrabox / Tandembox, Häfele Metalla 110-degree soft-close hinges, Hettich Cargo pull-outs.
- Countertops: Dekton Sintered Stone (12mm/20mm scratch resistant), Silestone Quartz.
- Warranty: 1-Year Comprehensive Execution Warranty + Snag-Free Handover Guarantee.
